Web & E-Commerce Development

Web & E-Commerce Development

Websites and online stores designed to convert-not just exist.

At TrendMakers, we build fast, secure and conversion-focused websites and e-commerce stores. We combine modern design, user experience and technical performance to drive real business results.

Book a call

What do we do in Web & E-Commerce Development?

We create clear, modern and high-performing digital experiences. Our websites and online stores integrate design, SEO, speed, security and analytics from day one.

  • We design modern websites with a strong UX/UI focus.
  • We build full online stores (Shopify / WooCommerce).
  • We optimize performance, security and technical SEO.
  • We connect your site with CRM, funnels and automations.

From slow websites to high-performing platforms

If any of this sounds familiar, this service is for you:

  • Your website feels outdated, slow or unprofessional.
  • Visitors don't clearly understand what you offer.
  • Your online store isn't converting or has constant issues.
  • You lack meaningful analytics about user behavior.

What's included in Web & E-Commerce Development?

We tailor every project to your goals, but we always work across development, online stores, performance and data.

Block 1 - Website Development

  • Modern, responsive design aligned with your brand.
  • Conversion-focused structure (landing pages, multi-page, corporate).
  • Implementation in HTML, WordPress or lightweight frameworks.
  • Lead-capturing sections and forms built-in.

Block 2 - Full E-Commerce Setup

  • Shopify or WooCommerce stores ready to operate.
  • Payment gateways and shipping integrations.
  • Catalog, variants and inventory management.
  • Automations connected to orders, carts and customers.

Block 3 - Technical SEO, Performance & Data

  • Core Web Vitals and speed optimization.
  • Technical SEO: indexing, sitemaps, metatags and on-page structure.
  • Google Analytics 4 events and Search Console setup.
  • CRM, funnel and automation integrations for complete tracking.

How do we deliver this service?

1

Step 1 - Planning & structure

We define objectives, content, features and the strategic role of your website.

2

We build or redesign your site/store with clarity, speed and a modern aesthetic.

Step 3 - Optimization & measurement

We integrate analytics, optimize performance and ensure everything is conversion-ready.

Expected outcomes

  • A modern and professional website or store.
  • Higher conversion rates from visitors to customers or leads.
  • Better performance in speed, SEO and stability.
  • Real visibility into user behavior and key metrics.
  • Stronger digital authority and trust.

Why choose TrendMakers for your website?

  • We design websites as part of a larger strategy-not just a visual piece.
  • We connect design, SEO, CRM and automation.
  • Strong technical performance and UX guaranteed.
  • Sites built to scale, without constant rebuilds.
